mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`post_comment`(id, post_id, user_id, content, reply_id, like_count, create_time) values (#{id}, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{replyId}, #{likeCount}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from booknest.`post_comment` where post_id = #{postId} order by create_time asc
mapper.update: update booknest.`post_comment` set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = #{id}
update booknest.`post_comment` set like_count = like_count - 1 where id = #{id}
